question: Which classical dancer was one of the youngest recipient of Padma Bhushan (1992) for her contributions to the field of classical dancing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonal Mansingh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sonal Mansingh** is a renowned classical dancer who was one of the youngest recipients of the Padma Bhushan in 1992.
 
• She has made significant contributions to the field of classical dancing, particularly in Odissi and Bharatanatyam dance forms.</li
